title: Broadcast a scalar
summary: A scalar is a single value. Broadcasting can apply it across all positions of a tensor.
introduction: A scalar is a single value. Broadcasting can apply it across all positions of a tensor. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A scalar is a single value. Broadcasting can apply it across all positions of a tensor.

blocks.code:
import tensorflow as tf

x = tf.constant([2, 4, 6])
print((x * 2).numpy().tolist())
blocks.title: Broadcast a scalar

blocks.text: The output is [4, 8, 12]. Each value is multiplied by 2.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Broadcasting still follows shape rules for non-scalar tensors.
